svg.text: ESR system architecture (origin/dev tip 2026-05-12, commit b74ca8b)
Mapping your original Excalidraw boxes -> actual code. RED = correction, BLUE = new (PR-0/PR-1).
Loaded at esrd boot; hot-reloaded via FSEvents.
agents.yaml DEPRECATED — agent_kinds now via plugin
runtime/lib/esr/* — registers, supervises, routes. No business logic.
NEW · PR-0/PR-1 (2026-05-12) — your 'URI' box is now this
resolve(uri) -> store lookup; alias 1-hop to canonical; miss -> plugin handler
-> ETS index: session URI, chat->session route
Peer topology inside a Session (one tree per session)
PtyProcess <- operator terminal attach, NOT on msg path
peer type = module implementing Esr.Entity.Proxy behaviour
Phoenix Sockets — WebSocket boundary to Python sidecars
Sensors / actuators for external systems. Emit Event / receive Directive.
NOTE: feishu/cc are NOT two adapter types,
they're instances of one generic mechanism.
Each plugin ships its own adapter impl.
MCP-over-WS to talk to Claude Code
CC pane started via tmux, NOT PtyProcess
cc_process is not a PtyProcess subscriber
★ THIS is your 'Biz Logic' — but it's a bottom layer, not a top concept.
